attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Font Awesome 5→6/7 upgrade renames many icon classes (fa-edit→fa-pen-to-square, fa-times→fa-xmark, far→fa-regular, fa-arrows-alt→fa-up-down-left-right, fa-trash-alt→fa-trash, etc.) across dozens of core admin views, so any theme/module overriding these views, extending them, or using old FA5 class names (including third-party FA CDN/version pinned sites) will show broken/missing icons, and the sheer breadth of touched shared admin templates makes regressions likely (e.g. the VisitSiteNavbarItem change introduces 'fa-width-auto' which isn't even a valid FA6/7 class, unlike the correct 'fa-fw' it replaced)."}
